categories.rationale: FastCGI translation is represented by a strict-valid candidate. NGINX stream now has a bounded translated subset (#426): direct/named-upstream TCP and UDP targets, proxy_timeout/proxy_connect_timeout, outbound PROXY protocol, and server_name+ssl_preread bounded SNI routing merged into one listener. Stream TLS termination, inbound stream PROXY protocol (nginx's stream module has no trusted-source directive for it), udp+proxy_protocol, unrecognized listen options, arbitrary stream maps, and mail remain explicit blocking evidence rather than silently omitted capability claims.
